evidence.title: File:Maltese honey cake, November 2008 (3045697754).jpg
evidence.description:
Another traditional Maltese delicacy is the Honey cake. There are other products which use honey as part of the ingredients, one of these is the honey ring or as known in Maltese ‘qaghaq tal-ghasel’.
   Honey Cake (Yield 12-inch cake) 
 
  Ingredients 
   
  500 g Honey 
 200 g Eggs 
 200 g Icing Sugar 
 800 g Soft Flour 
 30 g Bicarbonate of Soda 
 24 g Cinnamon Powder 
 16 g Ground Cloves 
 8 g Ground Nutmeg 
 300 ml Milk 
 400 g Flaked Almonds 
 200 g Chocolate  
  Method  
  Whisk icing sugar and eggs to form a sponge-like butter. 
 Add dissolved Honey. 
 Fold in the flour, bicarbonate of soda and spices. 
 Finally add the milk and almonds. 
 Place mix in a cake tin. 
 Bake at 175°C for approximately 40 minutes. 
 When cool, coat with chocolate.  
 Recipe by Andrew Farrugia, 
 
Pastry Lecturer at ITS - MALTA
